'''MT-4T''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The MT-4T Astromech Droid was a gift given to all players through their mailbox in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a gift for [[May 4|Star Wars Day]] starting on April 29, 2014.<ref name="TOR" />
